decisions.what: Pure CSS hamburger menu shown via .nav-toggle:focus, .site-nav:focus-within, or aria-expanded="true"
decisions.why: Spec requires a pure CSS menu; focus-based selectors keep it usable without JavaScript, and the aria-expanded selector lets future JS take over

decisions.what: Hero uses a brand gradient with a dark overlay pseudo-element instead of a photo
decisions.why: No images exist in the project yet; the overlay is ready for a background image later

decisions.what: Kenyan cultural accents done with CSS gradients (flag-colour stripe on hero, tri-colour heading underline)
decisions.why: Task asks for Kenyan visual elements without adding image weight on slow connections

decisions.what: No box-shadows on cards/sections; hover effects use transform only
decisions.why: Spec performance rules: avoid shadows on large elements, use transform for animation

decisions.what: Did not add scroll-reveal hidden states
decisions.why: Not in the spec, and the rules say content must stay visible by default without JS

decisions.what: Did not link styles.css from index.html
